title: What a turn knows of the world in the editor, and a hosted turn's plan v1 (world.turn.v1, world.plan.v1)
about: What the editor tells the conversation in its foot, sent with each turn (GitHub #13418): the world, its lane and revision, the selected thing, the point last tapped, the kinds and the things, and for a realm its lists of switches and its asks (#13528). And world.plan.v1: what a hosted turn asks the editor to do, a step a line, each step one of the hosted world tools. The editor shell writes the turn and reads the plan; the chat page reads the turn and writes the plan. Neither leaves the page.
